{{Quote|Welcome to Taris. I'm Captain Helid, Imperial Military Command.|Rankin|<ref name="DT" />}}
'''Helid''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] holding the rank of the [[Captain/Legends|captain]] in the [[Imperial Military (Sith Empire)|Imperial Military]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. During the [[Galactic War]] in [[3642 BBY]], he was stationed in the [[Toxic Lake Garrison]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Taris/Legends|Taris]].
